title: Blue Cheese Sauce for steaks and burgers
preamble:
100 ml white wine

100 g gorgonzola cheese (or another blue cheese), cut into small cubes

Salt, to taste
ingredients: 100 g gorgonzola cheese (or another blue cheese), cut into small cubes
method: Pour the wine in the same frying pan that you cooked the steaks in and leave to sizzle on a high heat for one minute. Stir with a wooden spoon.
Lower the heat to medium and add the gorgonzola cheese to the frying pan. Stir constantly with a wooden spoon for three minutes allowing the cheese to melt and create a smooth sauce.
Once ready, place one steak in the middle of each serving plate and drizzle the gorgonzola sauce over.
